dialogue.name: Illuso
dialogue.speech: What are you looking for here?

dialogue.name: Fugo
dialogue.speech: I have no intention of telling you.

dialogue.name: Illuso
dialogue.speech: I see.

dialogue.name: Illu
dialogue.speech: Very well. There are still two others.

dialogue.name: Illu
dialogue.speech: I just need the last one standing to tell me.

dialogue.name: Illu
dialogue.speech: You're finished. Take this!

dialogue.name: Illu
dialogue.speech: Footsteps... Someone outside the mirror is running.

dialogue.name: Illu
dialogue.speech: Does that mean your friends decided to

dialogue.name: JoJo-main
dialogue.speech: abandon you so that they could go get something?!

dialogue.name: Illu
dialogue.speech: They're heading toward the dog mosaic.

dialogue.name: Illu
dialogue.speech: That settles it.

dialogue.name: Illu
dialogue.speech: Fugo, you're basically done for already.

dialogue.name: Illu
dialogue.speech: I'm going to go get whatever that thing is first!

dialogue.name: Fugo
dialogue.speech: W-Wait, you b*stard!

dialogue.name: Fugo
dialogue.speech: Abbacchio... Giorno...

dialogue.name: Abba
dialogue.speech: Where is it? Where is this key?

dialogue.name: Abba
dialogue.speech: There it is. That must be it.

dialogue.name: Abba
dialogue.speech: A mirror?

dialogue.name: JoJo-main
dialogue.speech: Has that always been there?

dialogue.name: Illu
dialogue.speech: What is that? A key?

dialogue.name: Abba
dialogue.speech: What?

dialogue.name: Illu
dialogue.speech: I see.

dialogue.name: Illu
dialogue.speech: I guess I just have to take that key from you.

dialogue.name: Abba
dialogue.speech: That's... It couldn't be...

dialogue.name: Illu
dialogue.speech: Now that you've seen me,

dialogue.name: Illu
dialogue.speech: you're finished, too!

dialogue.name: JoJo-EpTitle,Sign
dialogue.speech: Episodio Mirror Man and Purple Smoke

dialogue.name: Abba
dialogue.speech: Sh-sh*t!

dialogue.name: Abba
dialogue.speech: Damn it...

dialogue.name: JoJo-main
dialogue.speech: I'm starting to understand the enemy's ability.

dialogue.name: Abba
dialogue.speech: So he's inside the mirror...

dialogue.name: JoJo-main
dialogue.speech: Assuming that's even possible.

dialogue.name: Abba
dialogue.speech: Fugo must've been dragged into the mirror and disappeared,

dialogue.name: Abba
dialogue.speech: separating him from his Stand.

dialogue.name: Abba
dialogue.speech: Regardless, right now, I need to grab that key!

dialogue.name: Illu
dialogue.speech: Shattering the mirror actually worked in my favor, Abbacchio.

dialogue.name: Illu
dialogue.speech: Anything reflected becomes an entrance to this world.

dialogue.name: Illu
dialogue.speech: Now that it's in shards, I have even more entrances to grab you from!

dialogue.name: Illu
dialogue.speech: And I'll give you, and only you, permission to come into the mirror!

dialogue.name: Illu
dialogue.speech: There! I've brought you in.

dialogue.name: Illu
dialogue.speech: I'll be taking that key, too!

dialogue.name: Illu
dialogue.speech: Wh-What?!

dialogue.name: Illu
dialogue.speech: O-Only a Stand can grab the neck of another Stand!

dialogue.name: Illu
dialogue.speech: There's no way you could grab Mirror Man's neckwhen I'm the one who dragged you in here!

dialogue.name: Abba
dialogue.speech: Shattering the mirror didn't actually work in your favor!

dialogue.name: Abba
dialogue.speech: It just means the space you can look outside from became smaller!

dialogue.name: Abba
dialogue.speech: You couldn't see who you dragged in here, could you?

dialogue.name: Abba
dialogue.speech: You gave permission...

dialogue.name: JoJo-main
dialogue.speech: for just me to enter?!

dialogue.name: Illu
dialogue.speech: Th-That's...

dialogue.name: Abba
dialogue.speech: Grazie! I'll happily get dragged in!

dialogue.name: Abba
dialogue.speech: Moody Jazz!

dialogue.name: Illu
dialogue.speech: sh*t! That's a Stand!

dialogue.name: Abba
dialogue.speech: Inside the mirror...

dialogue.name: JoJo-main
dialogue.speech: So it's a world where everything's reversed.

dialogue.name: Abba
dialogue.speech: Of course we couldn't know.

dialogue.name: JoJo-main
dialogue.speech: There's no way we'd comprehend this ability until we were actually attacked.

dialogue.name: Abba
dialogue.speech: Fugo must be in here, too.

dialogue.name: Abba
dialogue.speech: So, how do we get out of here?

dialogue.name: Abba
dialogue.speech: If I have to k*ll you to get out of here, that's fine.

dialogue.name: JoJo-main
dialogue.speech: That's why I sent Moody Jazz in there!

dialogue.name: Illu
dialogue.speech: The ability to transform into others...

dialogue.name: Illu
dialogue.speech: Well, sh*t. You got me.

dialogue.name: Abba
dialogue.speech: Looks like your Stand itself isn't that strong.

dialogue.name: Abba
dialogue.speech: So, what? Can it only defeat powerless humans?

dialogue.name: Abba
dialogue.speech: Well, what are you waiting for? Get on your feet and come at me!

dialogue.name: Illu
dialogue.speech: Listen up... Like I said at the start, you're already done for.

dialogue.name: Illu
dialogue.speech: I must say, I was a little surprised when it was your Stand that came in,

dialogue.name: Illu
dialogue.speech: but that doesn't change a thing!

dialogue.name: Illu
dialogue.speech: The reason I'm not standing is so that I can crouch down.

dialogue.name: Illu
dialogue.speech: I'm crouching because I need to!

dialogue.name: Abba
dialogue.speech: Well, yeah.

dialogue.name: Abba
dialogue.speech: You're bent over to make it easier to kick you.

dialogue.name: Illu
dialogue.speech: I was crouching so I could pick up this shard of the mirror!

dialogue.name: Illu
dialogue.speech: Hey, why are you so surprised?

dialogue.name: Illu
dialogue.speech: Is it because I have this arm?

dialogue.name: Illu
dialogue.speech: I'm sure you're very familiar with this arm!

dialogue.name: Illu
dialogue.speech: I told you! Anything that reflects becomes an entrance!

dialogue.name: Illu
dialogue.speech: If I can get your reflection with a different shard,

dialogue.name: Illu
dialogue.speech: that becomes another entrance!

dialogue.name: Illu
dialogue.speech: Do you get it now?

dialogue.name: Illu
dialogue.speech: It's your arm that I dragged in here!

dialogue.name: Illu
dialogue.speech: To make sure you can't move about, I'll only allow half of your body to come in.

dialogue.name: Illu
dialogue.speech: As for your Stand, I permit half of it to get out!

dialogue.name: Illu
dialogue.speech: Now your Stand won't be able to move!

dialogue.name: Illu
dialogue.speech: The key's mine!

dialogue.name: Abba
dialogue.speech: Damn it. He's going to take the key.

dialogue.name: Abba
dialogue.speech: That doesn't just mean we failed the mission.

dialogue.name: Abba
dialogue.speech: It also means that Giorno will end up being correct!

dialogue.name: Gio
dialogue.speech: And I humbly decline!

dialogue.name: Gio
dialogue.speech: We're going to solve this mystery, save Fugo, and defeat the enemy!

dialogue.name: Gio
dialogue.speech: That's the best way to ensure we're all safe!

dialogue.name: Abba
dialogue.speech: Damn it... My pride's not going to stand for that!

dialogue.name: Abba
dialogue.speech: I'm not letting him have that key!

dialogue.name: Abba
dialogue.speech: I swear on my pride and my dignity that I, Leone Abbacchio,

dialogue.name: Abba
dialogue.speech: will protect this key!

dialogue.name: Illu
dialogue.speech: It's true. Because Mirror Man uses all its energy to drag someone in,

dialogue.name: JoJo-main
dialogue.speech: it doesn't have much destructive power. That is indeed one of its traits!

dialogue.name: Illu
dialogue.speech: But if I do this to you, we don't exactly need strength to k*ll you off instantly!

dialogue.name: Illu
dialogue.speech: If we just stab this in with the strength of a four-year-old child, it's pretty easy.

dialogue.name: Illu
dialogue.speech: I win! Thanks for telling me where the key i—

dialogue.name: Abba
dialogue.speech: Something wrong? Go on, finish me off!

dialogue.name: Illu
dialogue.speech: What the hell are you doing, Abbacchio?!

dialogue.name: JoJo-main
dialogue.speech: How dare you hide it from me?!

dialogue.name: Illu
dialogue.speech: Even if you can move with your current body, it won't be much!

dialogue.name: Illu
dialogue.speech: I'll be able to tell immediately! Get it?!

dialogue.name: Abba
dialogue.speech: Hide?

dialogue.name: Abba
dialogue.speech: What are you talking about?

dialogue.name: Abba
dialogue.speech: What exactly did I hide, and where?

dialogue.name: Illu
dialogue.speech: What the hell are you doing, you b*stard?

dialogue.name: Illu
dialogue.speech: Let me see that hand!

dialogue.name: Illu
dialogue.speech: Seriously, what the hell are you doing, you b*stard?!

dialogue.name: Abba
dialogue.speech: Did you lose something?

dialogue.name: Abba
dialogue.speech: Did you find what you were looking for? Well?

dialogue.name: Illu
dialogue.speech: Why did he do that to his own hand?

dialogue.name: Illu
dialogue.speech: Wait... If he chopped off his own hand,

dialogue.name: Illu
dialogue.speech: his Stand's hand outside the mirror is...

dialogue.name: Illu
dialogue.speech: It can't be...

dialogue.name: Illu
dialogue.speech: Its hand is gone!

dialogue.name: Illu
dialogue.speech: Don't tell me...

dialogue.name: Illu
dialogue.speech: I-It has the key!

dialogue.name: Illu
dialogue.speech: And it's going back!

dialogue.name: Illu
dialogue.speech: If I remember correctly, a newbie named Giorno is just around the corner!

dialogue.name: Illu
dialogue.speech: He chopped off that hand to give him the key?!

dialogue.name: Abba
dialogue.speech: You should've sliced open my throat when you had the chance.

dialogue.name: Abba
dialogue.speech: If you had, my Stand's hand would've stopped moving.

dialogue.name: Abba
dialogue.speech: Whoops, so close. But you're a bit too late.

dialogue.name: Abba
dialogue.speech: That was the sound of the key falling to the ground.

dialogue.name: Abba
dialogue.speech: The key is going to get picked up!

dialogue.name: Illu
dialogue.speech: That's some bullshit you pulled off!

dialogue.name: Illu
dialogue.speech: But I'm not letting that brat named Giorno get away!

dialogue.name: Illu
dialogue.speech: I'll drag him in here, too!

dialogue.name: Abba
dialogue.speech: Do you understand now, Giorno, you shithead?!

dialogue.name: Abba
dialogue.speech: All that matters is that one of us returns safely.

dialogue.name: Abba
dialogue.speech: If you return safely with the key...

dialogue.name: Abba
dialogue.speech: The most important thing is to fulfill the mission.

dialogue.name: Illu
dialogue.speech: Hey, Abbacchio.

dialogue.name: Illu
dialogue.speech: Can you even imagine what's going on over here?

dialogue.name: Illu
dialogue.speech: You sure have a loyal companion.

dialogue.name: Illu
dialogue.speech: After you worked so hard to deliver the key...

dialogue.name: Illu
dialogue.speech: What do you think's going on over here?

dialogue.name: Illu
dialogue.speech: Not a damn thing!

dialogue.name: Illu
dialogue.speech: That brat's not running away at all!

dialogue.name: Illu
dialogue.speech: It looks like he doesn't have a clue what's going on.

dialogue.name: Abba
dialogue.speech: Giorno! Get the hell out of here!

dialogue.name: Abba
dialogue.speech: Take the key and run!

dialogue.name: Illu
dialogue.speech: He won't hear you when you're screaming inside this mirror!

dialogue.name: Abba
dialogue.speech: Sh-sh*t...

dialogue.name: Illu
dialogue.speech: Now then, there are two possible actions I could take.

dialogue.name: Illu
dialogue.speech: First is disposing of Giorno after I get the key.

dialogue.name: Illu
dialogue.speech: Second is slitting Giorno's throat first, then safely retrieving the key.

dialogue.name: Illu
dialogue.speech: Let's see...

dialogue.name: Illu
dialogue.speech: I guess I'll slit Giorno's throat first!

dialogue.name: Illu
dialogue.speech: He's noticed me.

dialogue.name: Illu
dialogue.speech: I'll allow only Giorno to enter!

dialogue.name: Illu
dialogue.speech: I've dragged him in!

dialogue.name: Illu
dialogue.speech: Slice open his throat, Mirror Man!

dialogue.name: Illu
dialogue.speech: Wh-Wh-What?!

dialogue.name: Illu
dialogue.speech: H-He's... That's impossible!

dialogue.name: Illu
dialogue.speech: It's the virus! G-Giorno...

dialogue.name: JoJo-main
dialogue.speech: He's been infected by Fugo's Purple Smoke!

dialogue.name: Gior
dialogue.speech: You're not getting the key!

dialogue.name: Gio
dialogue.speech: And Fugo, Abbacchio, and I... will safely return to the others!

dialogue.name: Sign
dialogue.speech: Pannacotta Fugo

dialogue.name: Sign
dialogue.speech: Purple Smoke

dialogue.name: Abba
dialogue.speech: Giorno Giovanna... That brat doesn't understand anything!

dialogue.name: Abba
dialogue.speech: You're going to die if you infect yourself with Purple Smoke's virus!

dialogue.name: Abba
dialogue.speech: My heart died along with him back then.

dialogue.name: Abba
dialogue.speech: I don't feel anything anymore.

dialogue.name: Abba
dialogue.speech: I don't feel a damn thing, even though I've lost my hand...

dialogue.name: Abba
dialogue.speech: The only time I can feel at ease

dialogue.name: JoJo-internal/narrator
dialogue.speech: is when I'm following the orders of something great and absolute.

dialogue.name: Abba
dialogue.speech: Because then, all I need to do is be a soldier who doesn't have to think for himself.

dialogue.name: Abba
dialogue.speech: Meaning...

dialogue.name: Abba
dialogue.speech: Getting the key and protecting the boss's daughter...

dialogue.name: Abba
dialogue.speech: Carrying out this mission is the most important thing.

dialogue.name: Abba
dialogue.speech: And yet Giorno... That stupid brat...

dialogue.name: Abba
dialogue.speech: He chose to put himself in danger to

dialogue.name: Abba
dialogue.speech: save Fugo and me, rather than taking the key back safely!

dialogue.name: Illu
dialogue.speech: Damn you, you stupid brat!

dialogue.name: JoJo-main
dialogue.speech: How dare you come in here infected?!

dialogue.name: Illu
dialogue.speech: Are you out of your damn mind?!

dialogue.name: Illu
dialogue.speech: Now I'm infected, damn it!

dialogue.name: Gio
dialogue.speech: Ah, yes. You seem to be experiencing the same symptoms as me.

dialogue.name: Gio
dialogue.speech: Apparently Purple Smoke's virus infects your whole body within thirty seconds.

dialogue.name: Gio
dialogue.speech: It's over now.

dialogue.name: Gio
dialogue.speech: It was over as soon as you dragged me in.

dialogue.name: Fugo
dialogue.speech: Shards of the mirror that Purple Smoke shattered...

dialogue.name: Fugo
dialogue.speech: Did Giorno put them back together?

dialogue.name: Fugo
dialogue.speech: When the enemy chased after Abbacchio, he took some shards with him.

dialogue.name: Fugo
dialogue.speech: Giorno must've realized that!

dialogue.name: Fugo
dialogue.speech: He then figured out the enemy's ability from that,

dialogue.name: Fugo
dialogue.speech: then infected himself with the virus and

dialogue.name: Fugo
dialogue.speech: allowed himself to be dragged into the mirror!

dialogue.name: Fugo
dialogue.speech: Because there's no other way to defeat this enemy!

dialogue.name: Illu
dialogue.speech: Damn it! Of all the underhanded...

dialogue.name: Illu
dialogue.speech: But don't underestimate me.

dialogue.name: Illu
dialogue.speech: It's not too late yet.

dialogue.name: Illu
dialogue.speech: I need more resolve, but it's not too late yet!

dialogue.name: Illu
dialogue.speech: Mirror Man! Allow only me to leave this mirror!

dialogue.name: Illu
dialogue.speech: But don't allow the virus!

dialogue.name: Illu
dialogue.speech: The part of me that's infected is not allowed to leave!

dialogue.name: Gio
dialogue.speech: That's not good!

dialogue.name: JoJo-main
dialogue.speech: If he gets outside, the virus will be separated from him!

dialogue.name: Illu
dialogue.speech: Abbacchio lopped off his own hand to get the key.

dialogue.name: Illu
dialogue.speech: So, I, Illuso, c-can do the same thing!

dialogue.name: Illu
dialogue.speech: This is nothing!

dialogue.name: Fugo
dialogue.speech: Giorno! Grab him!

dialogue.name: Fugo
dialogue.speech: He got away...

dialogue.name: Fugo
dialogue.speech: Giorno... After you...

dialogue.name: Fugo
dialogue.speech: risked your own life to come in here...

dialogue.name: Gio
dialogue.speech: So... he stepped outside the mirror.

dialogue.name: Illu
dialogue.speech: Th-That was really close, but, ha!

dialogue.name: Illu
dialogue.speech: My resolve... My resolve wins in the end!

dialogue.name: Illu
dialogue.speech: This is nothing!

dialogue.name: Giorno
dialogue.speech: I figured he'd go outside.

dialogue.name: Gio
dialogue.speech: That's for the best, though. He's going down, no matter what.

dialogue.name: Gio
dialogue.speech: Now that he's stepped outside, there's a chance I might survive!

dialogue.name: Gio
dialogue.speech: Fugo! Now that he's outside, Purple Smoke can follow him!

dialogue.name: Gio
dialogue.speech: Finish him off!

dialogue.name: Fugo
dialogue.speech: I can't, Giorno.

dialogue.name: Fugo
dialogue.speech: I can't tell where he is from inside here.

dialogue.name: Fugo
dialogue.speech: I have no way to attack him!

dialogue.name: Gio
dialogue.speech: I know where he is.

dialogue.name: Gio
dialogue.speech: Golden Wind, who's outside, turned that brick into a snake.

dialogue.name: Gio
dialogue.speech: That's why it's moving.

dialogue.name: Gio
dialogue.speech: Snakes can tell where humans are by sensing their body temperature.

dialogue.name: Fugo
dialogue.speech: Got him!

dialogue.name: Illu
dialogue.speech: What?!

dialogue.name: JoJo-main
dialogue.speech: A-After I built up the resolve to chop off my own arm and came out here...

dialogue.name: Illu
dialogue.speech: This... This can't...

dialogue.name: Illu
dialogue.speech: S-Stop it! Stop! Damn it!

dialogue.name: Illu
dialogue.speech: I'm going to be infected! I-If that virus capsule bursts...

dialogue.name: Illu
dialogue.speech: I-It looks like luck hasn't completely abandoned me!

dialogue.name: Illu
dialogue.speech: If Mirror Man can stop this thing's punch even for a moment...

dialogue.name: Illu
dialogue.speech: If I can just block it once...

dialogue.name: Fugo
dialogue.speech: Let him have it, Purple Smoke!

dialogue.name: Illu
dialogue.speech: Mirror Man! Use everything you have left!

dialogue.name: Illu
dialogue.speech: I did it...

dialogue.name: Illu
dialogue.speech: I stopped it! Now I just need to take this arm...

dialogue.name: Illu
dialogue.speech: into the mirror!

dialogue.name: Illu
dialogue.speech: Huh?

dialogue.name: Illu
dialogue.speech: What?!

dialogue.name: Illu
dialogue.speech: What?!

dialogue.name: Illu
dialogue.speech: B-But I blocked its punch...

dialogue.name: Illu
dialogue.speech: After I built up the resolve... to leave the mirror!

dialogue.name: Fugo
dialogue.speech: W-We did it! We're outside the mirror!

dialogue.name: Fugo
dialogue.speech: We defeated him, so his ability disappeared!

dialogue.name: Fugo
dialogue.speech: B-But Giorno, Purple Smoke's virus has already spread throughout your body.

dialogue.name: Fugo
dialogue.speech: Once you've been infected, even I can't do anything about it.

dialogue.name: Gio
dialogue.speech: Yes, Fugo, and this is how it should be.

dialogue.name: Gio
dialogue.speech: This...

dialogue.name: Gio
dialogue.speech: Him leaving the mirror worked out for the best.

dialogue.name: Gio
dialogue.speech: Once I was infected and he dragged me into the mirror,

dialogue.name: Gio
dialogue.speech: his defeat was inevitable.

dialogue.name: Gio
dialogue.speech: But I was glad when he refused to admit defeat and left the mirror.

dialogue.name: Gio
dialogue.speech: Since the mirror world was undone before I died,

dialogue.name: Gio
dialogue.speech: I was able to encounter this snake.

dialogue.name: Fugo
dialogue.speech: Th-That snake...

dialogue.name: Fugo
dialogue.speech: It's alive, even though it's surrounded by Purple Smoke's virus!

dialogue.name: Gio
dialogue.speech: I created this snake from the brick where Purple Smoke's capsule was broken.

dialogue.name: Gio
dialogue.speech: Since it was born from a place that was covered with the virus, it won't get sick.

dialogue.name: Gio
dialogue.speech: Do you know what that means?

dialogue.name: Fugo
dialogue.speech: That snake has immunity!

dialogue.name: Fugo
dialogue.speech: And if we take blood or cells from something with immunity...

dialogue.name: Fugo
dialogue.speech: We can create a serum that'll stop the virus from spreading!

dialogue.name: Gio
dialogue.speech: Golden Wind!

dialogue.name: Gio
dialogue.speech: Extract the serum from this snake and inject it into me!

dialogue.name: Fugo
dialogue.speech: Giorno Giovanna...

dialogue.name: Fugo
dialogue.speech: I thought he was some newbie that I just couldn't figure out,

dialogue.name: Fugo
dialogue.speech: but he comes up with the most insane ideas and pulls them off...

dialogue.name: Fugo
dialogue.speech: And there's something I can trust behind that.

dialogue.name: Fugo
dialogue.speech: It's not something that's spoken.

dialogue.name: Fugo
dialogue.speech: He has true loyalty within him!

dialogue.name: Fugo
dialogue.speech: Just like Bucciarati did back then!

dialogue.name: Fugo
dialogue.speech: Giorno! You have my utmost respect after risking your life!

dialogue.name: Gio
dialogue.speech: No, Fugo...

dialogue.name: Gio
dialogue.speech: I'm not the one who risked my life here.

dialogue.name: Gio
dialogue.speech: I just made a prediction and followed through.

dialogue.name: Gio
dialogue.speech: The one who truly risked his life here... was Abbacchio.

dialogue.name: Gio
dialogue.speech: His hand is in grave condition right now.

dialogue.name: Gio
dialogue.speech: He's the one who risked his life to protect the key...

dialogue.name: Gio
dialogue.speech: And if he hadn't carried the key all the way here,

dialogue.name: Gio
dialogue.speech: we couldn't have defeated the enemy.

dialogue.name: Gio
dialogue.speech: Please don't worry about me... and go tend to his wounds...

dialogue.name: Fugo
dialogue.speech: Giorno!

dialogue.name: Fugo
dialogue.speech: Are you okay, Giorno?!

dialogue.name: Abba
dialogue.speech: Damn it, Giorno...

dialogue.name: Abba
dialogue.speech: I was going...

dialogue.name: JoJo-main
dialogue.speech: to beat the sh*t out of you...

dialogue.name: Abba
dialogue.speech: But with my hand like this, I guess I can't.

dialogue.name: Abba
dialogue.speech: I'll just have to do it later...

dialogue.name: Nar
dialogue.speech: Thus, they got the key they were ordered to retrieve!
